title: Tropical Storm Florence, SCNG Responds
description: South Carolina National Guard LMTVs from the 1178th Forward Support  Company, deployed from Myrtle Beach, South Carolina conduct high-water evacuation support in Bennettsville, South Carolina, since early morning September 16, 2018. Currently, more than 3,600 SCNG Soldiers and Airmen have been activated in direct support of South Carolinians affected by Hurricane Florence, which was recently downgraded to a tropical storm. (U.S. National Guard photo by Senior Master Sgt. Edward Snyder)
